name: issue-resolver/third-failure-premise-reset
prompt: Two QA fixes fail under one premise; the third fix is blocked until a rerun diagnostic supports a revised premise (issue #519)

grade.label: premise outcomes recorded: blocked after two shared failures, unblocked by a matching rerun, blocked on a mismatch
the diagnostic was actually rerun and its output kept
the grader is not vacuous — an absent artifact fails

criteria: The two failed fixes are recognised as one premise even though the fixer worded it differently.
The third fix is not sent while the premise stands.
The revised premise is supported by a diagnostic that reran to its recorded result.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in exercises the real gi-premise.py with a real rerun diagnostic, not live agent behavior.
